title: Is Grammarly Worth It in 2026? Pricing & Business Verdict

facts.fact: Grammarly's Pro plan costs around $12 per member per month when billed annually, according to Grammarly's own pricing page as cited by the guide.
facts.quote: Pro costs around $12 per member per month billed annually, or about $30 per month billed monthly, per Grammarly's own pricing page.

facts.fact: The guide states that Grammarly's Free plan costs $0 and includes around 100 AI prompts per month.
facts.quote: Free — $0. Basic grammar, spelling, tone signals, and around 100 AI prompts per month.

facts.fact: The guide states that the Pro plan includes around 2,000 AI prompts per member per month, 1 style guide, and 1 brand tone.
facts.unit: AI prompts per member per month
facts.quote: Adds rewrites, tone adjustment, plagiarism and AI-text detection, ~2,000 AI prompts/member/month, 1 style guide, 1 brand tone, and team analytics.

facts.fact: Grammarly now offers three tiers, Free, Pro, and Enterprise, and Pro replaced both the old Premium and Business plans.
facts.quote: Grammarly now offers three tiers: Free, Pro, and Enterprise. Pro replaced both the old Premium and Business plans

facts.fact: Grammarly's Pro plan works for individuals and teams up to 149 seats.
facts.quote: Pro replaced both the old Premium and Business plans and works for individuals and teams up to 149 seats.

facts.fact: Grammarly reports that for annual Pro plans with 10 or more members, it can issue invoices payable by ACH, wire, or card.
facts.quote: Grammarly reports for annual Pro with 10+ members it can issue invoices payable by ACH, wire, or card

facts.fact: The guide states that Pro includes 1 style guide and 1 brand tone, while Enterprise offers unlimited style guides and brand tones.
facts.quote: Watch the limits: Pro includes 1 style guide and 1 brand tone.

facts.fact: The guide claims that paying month to month roughly doubles the cost per seat compared with the annual headline rate.
facts.quote: Paying month to month roughly doubles the cost per seat.

facts.fact: Grammarly's Enterprise plan is quote-based and adds SAML SSO, SCIM, admin controls, data-loss prevention, audit logs, BYOK encryption, and unlimited style guides and brand tones.
facts.quote: Adds SAML SSO, SCIM, admin controls, data-loss prevention, audit logs, BYOK encryption, and unlimited style guides and brand tones.

facts.fact: Grammarly states it holds a SOC 2 Type II report covering security, privacy, availability, and confidentiality.
facts.quote: Grammarly states it holds a SOC 2 (Type II) report covering security, privacy, availability, and confidentiality

facts.fact: Grammarly states it lists GDPR and CCPA compliance and 256-bit AES encryption.
facts.quote: it lists GDPR and CCPA compliance plus 256-bit AES encryption

facts.fact: According to the page, Grammarly Enterprise adds SAML SSO, SCIM, data-loss prevention, audit logs, and BYOK encryption.
facts.quote: Enterprise adds SAML SSO, SCIM, data-loss prevention, audit logs, and BYOK encryption.
